# 闪烁 ![logo_full_ alpha_bg](https://github.com/Low-Drag-MC/Shimmer/assets/26162862/ecc3a347-2e41-4ba2-a426-d5b36eab503c)
Shimmer是一个专注于渲染效果的模组
幻想光晕和彩色灯光
支持可配置的Json和Java api
定制你喜欢的内容
加入我们的 [![discord](https://shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Us-blue?logo=Discord&style=flat)](https://discord.gg/CQywkfwPrC) [![discord](https://shields.io/badge/QQ-755790169-red?logo=tencentqq&style=flat)](https://discord.gg/CQywkfwPrC) 用于沟通、问题反馈

Modrinth首页 | CurseForge首页

## 光晕 ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26162862/201468458-021dedc4-d883-44d2-961a-d2f38110fae4.png) ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26162862/201468409-8c2a50f3-f2a9-435a-b6d5-bed59a69a1c3.png) ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26162862/201468589-eea3553d-1424-4b58-9ac5-083660187677.png) 与 [MadParticle](https://github.com/USS-Shenzhou/MadParticle) 兼容 ![Jnm1LVVLyq17t0us](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26162862/201468947-60a1d80f-b9f4-4d4f-a130-ac94fbb3efad.gif) ## 彩色灯光 ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18493855/170466919-65ca5b39-7397-45f9-99ed-c9a8d72cec70.png) ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26162862/201469162-5daeff42-8450-4cc7-a3f8-6e4ed0e7ceb2.png) 与 [Lighting Wand](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/lighting-wand) 兼容 ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26162862/201469108-4d48a6ea-422b-4218-8463-3e89484f7901.png) 视频 [在此](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-OXVb8edD7o&ab_channel=Snownee) ## 配置 Shimmer还拥有强大的配置系统，面向无代码用户和Java API，请参阅**wiki**获取详细信息。此外，我们还提供了强大的图形界面以便快速配置。 ### 辅助屏幕 ![gif](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26162862/195899429-75fb0db4-a919-4a4b-bb0d-b7bb4c8b7222.gif) ### 吸管工具 ![gif](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26162862/199932496-056e548b-bfc6-4a46-bef3-d9843782d165.gif) ## 对模组开发者而言 为了将Shimmer导入你的开发环境： ```gradle repositories{ //首先添加我们的Maven仓库 maven { url "https://maven.firstdarkdev.xyz/snapshots" } } // Forge implementation fg.deobf("com.lowdragmc.shimmer:Shimmer-forge:${minecraft_version}:${shimmer_version}") // Fabric modImplementation "com.lowdragmc.shimmer:Shimmer-fabric:${minecraft_version}:${shimmer_version}" // 对于Architectury用户，你也可以直接导入shimmer的通用jar包到你的通用模块中 modImplementation "com.lowdragmc.shimmer:Shimmer-common:${minecraft_version}:${shimmer_version}" ``` 最后，特别感谢[WenXin2'S](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/blooming-blocks)制作的资源包
